title: Chinese-Style Mussels Stew
description: A hearty, savory stew inspired by Chinese cuisine, featuring mussels and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mussels, soy sauce, and intensely savory sauce; stir to combine.
Add the Korean chili flakes, if using.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the mussels start to open.
Sprinkle the cornstarch over the mussels and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the mussels hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
Optional: serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
